messages:
Lena: Heads-up: quick design review of model-catalog compare UI. Goals: keep filters discoverable after scroll, make perf badges scannable, and improve pin copy for clarity. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/model-catalog
Ravi: My two cents: collapse chips into a single compact rail item on scroll. Show 'Filters (3)' with a chevron. Clicking expands inline.
Priya (PM): agree but add a microcopy hint when collapsed: 'Filters hidden 37  expand'. Users shouldn't think filters disappeared.
Kai (Eng): FYI implementation: virtualized rows + sticky rail caused a 1-2px layout jitter in our last build. Plan: reserve top offset and use transform to avoid repaints. Suggest `position: sticky; top: 80px; transform: translateZ(0)`.
Tess (A11y): A11y checklist: collapsed pill must be keyboard-focusable, use `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, on expand focus moves to first filter. Tooltip content must be accessible via keyboard.
Lena: Badges: show compact text like 'P99: 120ms' on card. Tooltip (hover/focus) shows fuller context plus cost-per-M tokens on second line.
Kai (Eng): Tooltips at scale -> lazy DOM injection on hover/focus to limit nodes. Also prefer one tooltip component reused per page.
Priya (PM): Pin copy: change to 'Pin for compare' and add tiny helper under version: 'Pinned  stays in compare lists'. Also track `pin_action_failure_rate`.
Ravi: Anim for pin toggle: subtle 120ms scale+fade, but respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. If API fails, show inline toast: 'Pin failed. Retry' with CTA.
deploy-bot: Preview deployed for branch `catalog/compact-rail` at https://preview.redwood.ai/compare/compact-rail (expires in 48h)
Lena: Action items: Ravi update figma comps; Tess publish 5-item a11y checklist; Kai spike sticky with reserved header; Priya finalize copy + telemetry. Target: next sprint.
